name: alpamayo-r1-10b
prompt: What color is the vehicle in this image? Answer in one word.
notes: Alpamayo-R1-10B is NVIDIA's autonomous-driving VLA model — VLM backbone (Cosmos-Reason2-8B = Qwen3-VL) + 2.3B action expert + flow-matching diffusion trajectory decoder. This lane covers the VLM portion only: the alpamayo_r1 plugin pairs the Alpamayo weights with the Cosmos-Reason2-8B Qwen3-VL config (hardcoded in the plugin since Alpamayo's config.json lacks text_config/vision_config) and delegates to the qwen_vl family. Action expert + traj tokenizer + flow-matching are out of scope.
